description: For jobsite safety, this inspection checklist records task hazards, competent-person controls, PPE, access protection, emergency contacts, and weather limits. Its supporting evidence includes pre-task briefing record, inspection observations, control photos, permits, and corrective-action verification.

blocks.guidance: Verify the jobsite safety condition before marking.
items: Verify energy-isolation, lockout and tagout, and zero-energy confirmation
Inspect scaffold tags, guardrails, ladder setup, anchorage, and fall-arrest rescue plan
Confirm trench protective system, spoil setback, atmospheric test, and competent-person release
Control silica, welding fumes, hot work, combustion exhaust, and respiratory exposure
Establish barricades, spotters, swing-radius exclusion, traffic control, and pedestrian detours
Locate emergency eyewash, extinguishers, first aid, muster point, and rescue contacts

use_case: Use the inspection checklist during jobsite hazard assessment and control verification when the jobsite safety record must identify work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces. Complete the applicable handoff for competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger.
